spec_match.rationale: Validates the real .well-known/related-website-set.json format fields (primary, associatedSites, serviceSites, ccTLDs) and frames the Chrome 153 removal honestly: the manifest grants nothing once the rollout lands.

interactive.rationale: Editable JSON textarea, validate button, valid/invalid presets, live error/warning/info results, and a field-status grid.

blurb_alignment.rationale: Matches the index card; the refile also fixed the card and note to stop implying Chrome 153 'still reads' the manifest for grants.

edge_cases.rationale: JSON parse errors, invalid URLs, wrong field types, and the always-present deprecation warning were all exercised; the invalid preset renders two errors plus the warning.

references.rationale: Links ChromeStatus feature 5194473869017088, the RWS repo, and MDN Storage Access API.

conformance.rationale: Feature-level v153 suite covers the removal/survivor contract; this page's validator is format tooling on top of it.

runtime_evidence.rationale: Feature harness run passed desktop+mobile (screenshots read). CDP sweep validated the default manifest, loaded the invalid preset (errors rendered), reloaded the valid preset (4-row field grid) — zero console errors/exceptions/failed requests.

telemetry_health.rationale: Shared demo-telemetry shell active; validation output is explicit text per finding.

design_system.rationale: Design-system variables only; results use emerald/rose text on paper with textual ✓/✗ markers.

accessibility.rationale: The manifest textarea now has a meaningful accessible name ('Related website set manifest JSON', fixed from the predecessor's 'Json input'); results are textual with symbols plus words.

mobile_desktop_parity.rationale: Feature harness passed both classes; the field grid's fixed 150px key column still fits 360px, and the textarea is width-bound with border-box.

guidanceConsulted.query: accessible live status output for feature detection probes and async API results
guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Form fields need meaningful accessible names; validation findings should be conveyed as text.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: Renamed the textarea's aria-label to 'Related website set manifest JSON'; findings render as ✗/⚠/✓ lines with full sentences.

summary: v153 refile of rws-validator. Copy corrected for the Chrome 153 removal rollout (deprecation since 144; the manifest grants nothing once removal lands) and the textarea's accessible name repaired. Verified via the responsive harness and a CDP sweep across valid/invalid presets with zero console errors.
